description: MerLin adaptation: photonic_accuracy_original with the exact photonic shift rule instead of the two-point pi/2 shift: per phase, the fidelity at 4 shifts ((2mu-1) pi/4, mu = 1..4; 2 photons give frequencies up to 2) plus one unshifted circuit per sample, gradient of -log F = -F'/F; simultaneous update through the co-Manager on 2 workers, weights in [0, pi], 25 epochs.
